# .github

## PURPOSE
GitHub workflow and release automation support.

## WHAT_BELONGS_HERE
- GitHub Actions workflows.
- GitHub release workflow notes and issue/PR templates when added.

## WHAT_DOES_NOT_BELONG_HERE
- Secrets or plaintext credentials.
- Local build artifacts.
- KiCad project source files.

## AI_AGENT_RULES
- Do not add required paid services.
- Do not publish releases automatically unless explicitly configured and approved.

## SAFE_EDIT_RULES
- Keep workflows conservative and artifact-focused.
- Prefer draft releases and uploaded artifacts over automatic public publishing.

## PUBLIC_RELEASE_NOTES
- Workflows must not require private secrets for basic open-source builds.
